input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: explore: daylight-saving day-step bugs in venture date math

deviations.why: No agent doc in docs/reports/: the lint's docstring and the post carry what the next run needs.

notes: Idea: timezone bugs CI cannot see because it runs in UTC. Found saas-seat-true-up subtracting days*MS_PER_DAY from a local-midnight renewal: 2026-04-01 with 30 days' notice showed 2026-03-01 in America/New_York (should be 2026-03-02). Fixed with calendar-day steps plus a TZ=America/New_York child-process test (fails on old code). Added platform/ci/check_dst_day_step.py + test_check_dst_day_step.py (3 unittest cases pass; 0 venture hits after fix, 2 before). Swept every venture test suite under TZ=America/New_York with xargs -P4 and a 120 s per-venture timeout: 1,348 suites, 1,344 passed, 4 timed out under load (changepoint-detector, league-schedule-generator, shed-designer, shift-roster-builder) and passed when rerun alone (698, 517, 514, 611 tests, 0 failures). So 1,348/1,348 pass under New York; the sweep found nothing beyond the code-read bug (the seat tool's own old tests also passed there, since none crossed DST).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: find and fix the DST bug with a TZ test, write and test a lint, run and triage a 1,348-suite sweep, write the post

certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
